title: DRI seizes four elephant tusks, ivory articles in Hyderabad's Banjara Hills; three held
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TELANGANA
verified_by: The Hindu bureau report, article fetched and fact-matched 2026-10-02
bullets_en: DRI Hyderabad seized four elephant tusks weighing about 17 kg in Banjara Hills.
Three people were held while allegedly selling the ivory to buyers.
Carved trophies and articles seized under the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972.
Trade in elephant ivory and items made from it is banned across India, DRI said.
bullets_ur: DRI Hyderabad ne Banjara Hills mein chaari haathi ke daant jabt kiye, wazan taqreeban 17 kilo.
Ivory ki farokht ke shak mein teen mulzameen rangehaaye dabooch liye gaye.
Nakkaashi wale daant aur mamoolat Wild Life (Protection) Act 1972 ke tehat jabt hue.
DRI ke mutabiq poore mulk mein haathi ke daanton ka karobaar sakhti se mamnoona hai.
